title: RNA Extraction Cell Lysis and Preparation

steps.title: Aspirate and discard the culture medium from…
steps.description: Aspirate and discard the culture medium from the cells.

steps.title: Wash the cells once with 1 mL sterile PBS to…
steps.description: Wash the cells once with 1 mL sterile PBS to remove residual medium.

steps.title: Add 500 µL of RNA lysis buffer directly onto…
steps.description: Add 500 µL of RNA lysis buffer directly onto the cells in the dish.

steps.title: Pipette up and down 5–10 times to lyse and…
steps.description: Pipette up and down 5–10 times to lyse and homogenize the cells completely.

steps.title: Transfer the lysate into a sterile RNase-free…
steps.description: Transfer the lysate into a sterile RNase-free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add an equal volume of 70% ethanol to the…
steps.description: Add an equal volume of 70% ethanol to the lysate and mix gently by pipetting.
